name: Prantik Dutta
title: Prantik Dutta's Portfolio
intro: Senior creative strategist and creative post producer. Research, brand direction and briefs through writing, shoots, editing, AI, VFX and team leadership.
about: I turn research into brand direction, campaigns and briefs, then lead the team through production and post. I write, plan and shoot, and lead editing, graphics, AI and VFX through delivery. Knowing the whole process helps me bring the right people together and keep the idea intact. Sustainable teams, shorter turnarounds, reach, retention and data are part of the work.
